hunks.baseline: A spearhead wreathed in blue flame came plunging down toward the crown of a man's head.
hunks.sol: A spearhead wreathed in blue flame plunged toward the crown of a man’s head.

hunks.baseline: It was the claw of a fire dragon descending from the heavens—a destructive force capable of erasing anything that stood in its way.
hunks.sol: It was the claw of a fire dragon descending from the heavens—a force of destruction that could erase anything in its path.

hunks.baseline: *This is…*
hunks.sol: *This…*

hunks.baseline: Within a moment split into ever-smaller fragments, the Western Heaven Demon Lord thought.
hunks.sol: In a moment split into ever-smaller fragments, the Western Heaven Demon Lord thought,

hunks.baseline: *I can't evade it.*
hunks.sol: *I can’t evade it.*

hunks.baseline: This was not a strike he could avoid by taking a few steps back.
hunks.sol: This was no strike he could avoid by retreating a few steps.

hunks.baseline: Then what should he do? Before he could even form the question, the body that had survived countless life-and-death duels was already moving.
hunks.sol: Then what could he do? Before he could even form the question, the body that had survived countless life-and-death duels was already moving.

hunks.baseline: A dark-red Sword Force shot up from his waist and collided with the blue flames.
hunks.sol: Dark-red Sword Force surged from his waist and collided with the blue flames.

hunks.baseline: A shock wave swept through my entire body with a tremendous roar. My ears rang, and the breath caught in my throat.
hunks.sol: A tremendous roar erupted, and a shock wave swept through my entire body. My ears went numb, and the breath caught in my throat.

hunks.baseline: The sword and spear collided, releasing a flash of dark-red light. In the next instant, I was flying far away as if someone had yanked me backward.
hunks.sol: Sword and spear collided in a burst of dark-red light. The next instant, I went flying as though someone had yanked me backward.

hunks.baseline: I knocked away a stalactite falling toward my eyes and twisted my body around.
hunks.sol: I knocked away a stalactite falling toward my eyes and twisted around in midair.

hunks.baseline: The instant my feet touched the ground, the solid stone floor gouged open like a plowed field.
hunks.sol: The instant my feet hit the ground, they plowed furrows through the solid stone floor.

hunks.sol: Even through the thick cloud of dust, I could see the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s stiff expression.

hunks.baseline: He silently looked down at the sword blade broken clean in half and his blood-soaked grip before opening his mouth.
hunks.sol: He silently studied the sword broken clean in half, then his blood-soaked hand.

hunks.baseline: “Divine weapon? That’s a bit much.”
hunks.sol: “Divine? That’s a bit much.”

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes swept over my entire body.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s gaze swept over me.

hunks.baseline: “Cheongpung, the young man who reached Supreme Peak at such a young age, is certainly remarkable, but he is not as remarkable as you. To be honest, yes. You have far exceeded my expectations. You wounded me despite being merely at Peak.”
hunks.sol: “Cheongpung is certainly remarkable, reaching Supreme Peak at such a young age, but even he cannot compare to you. To be honest, you have far exceeded my expectations. Despite being only at Peak, you managed to wound me.”

hunks.baseline: I was not surprised. I had already vaguely realized that Cheongpung had broken through the wall and reached Supreme Peak.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t surprised. I had already sensed that Cheongpung had broken through the wall and reached Supreme Peak.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s accurate assessment of my martial arts realm followed the same logic.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord had discerned my realm just as easily.

hunks.sol: “My execution of Four Ounces Deflecting a Thousand Catties was flawless. Yet I still failed to redirect your strike completely. A strike from a green young man who has not even advanced beyond Peak.”

hunks.sol: He wasn’t facing an ordinary Peak master.

hunks.baseline: The higher one’s realm, the wider the gap became, and the more distant the difference in strength grew. That was the common sense of this world—the Murim.
hunks.sol: The higher the realm, the wider the gulf and the more overwhelming the difference in strength. That was common sense in this world—the common sense of the Murim.

hunks.baseline: But I was an existence that defied common sense.
hunks.sol: But I defied common sense.

hunks.baseline: “Call me a physically strong Supreme Peak master.”
hunks.sol: “Call me a physical Supreme Peak master.”

hunks.baseline: “A physically strong Supreme Peak master. I do not know what that means, but if that is what you are, then so be it. Understood.”
hunks.sol: “A physical Supreme Peak master. I have no idea what that means, but if you say so, then so be it. Understood.”

hunks.baseline: I stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord as he nodded, utterly dumbfounded.
hunks.sol: I stared at the nodding Western Heaven Demon Lord in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: “…What exactly do you understand?”
hunks.sol: “…What the hell do you understand?”

hunks.baseline: “Living a long time exposes one to all sorts of experiences. Compared to the supernatural powers I have known, what you have shown is merely a drop in the bucket.”
hunks.sol: “Live long enough and you experience all manner of things. Compared to the supernatural powers I know of, what you’ve shown is merely a drop in the bucket.”

hunks.baseline: His movement was so natural that it was hard to believe he had been one-armed until only ten days ago.
hunks.sol: The movement was so natural that it was hard to believe he had been one-armed until only ten days ago.

hunks.baseline: That arm was certainly included among the supernatural powers he had mentioned.
hunks.sol: That arm had to be one of the supernatural powers he was talking about.

hunks.baseline: “Everything will unfold according to the will of the most exalted Lord of Heaven. Now, why not abandon your futile hopes and surrender?”
hunks.sol: “Everything shall unfold according to the will of the most exalted Lord of Heaven. Why not abandon your futile hopes and surrender?”

hunks.baseline: “If you do so, I will personally petition the Lord of Heaven to put you to good use. Even the Blood Lord will not dare touch you.”
hunks.sol: “If you do, I will personally petition the Lord of Heaven to put your talents to good use. Even the Blood Lord will not dare touch you.”

hunks.baseline: “Wow, you’ve got it all planned out.”
hunks.sol: “Wow. You’ve got it all planned out.”

hunks.baseline: I slowly walked toward the Western Heaven Demon Lord as I continued speaking.
hunks.sol: I slowly walked toward the Western Heaven Demon Lord as I continued.

hunks.baseline: “Stories like this always end with good triumphing over evil anyway. So stop fooling around in some place called Dark Heaven or Cheonggyecheon and come over to the orthodox faction. I’ll put in a good word with Grandpa Sword Saint and get you an easy job.”
hunks.sol: “Stories like this always end with good triumphing over evil anyway. So stop screwing around in Dark Heaven or Cheonggyecheon or whatever and come over to the orthodox faction. I’ll put in a good word with Grandpa Sword Saint and get you an easy job.”

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord took a step forward with a faint smile.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord stepped forward with a faint smile.

hunks.baseline: “That is unfortunate. Do not come to regret it when you meet the Blood Lord.”
hunks.sol: “What a pity. Don’t regret this when you meet the Blood Lord.”

hunks.baseline: “Every bastard who’s said that to me is now bowing their head before Yama.”
hunks.sol: “Every bastard who’s said that to me is kneeling with his head planted before Yama by now.”

hunks.baseline: “You are young, so your blood runs hot. If you are hoping for the same luck you had at the start, forget it. I know that strike was your full strength.”
hunks.sol: “Perhaps it’s your youth, but you’re far too hot-blooded. If you expect the same stroke of luck you enjoyed at the start, forget it. I know that strike was your full strength.”

hunks.baseline: I answered him casually, but unfortunately, the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s words were true.
hunks.sol: I answered casually, but unfortunately, the Western Heaven Demon Lord was right.

hunks.baseline: A surprise attack had to end with a single strike. Either render the opponent unable to fight or kill them.
hunks.sol: A surprise attack had to end everything in one strike. Either cripple the opponent or kill them.

hunks.baseline: Breaking a weapon and tearing open a hand was not enough.
hunks.sol: Breaking his weapon and tearing open his hand wasn’t enough.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord was a master far above me. Showing him my full strength and still failing to inflict any significant injury had been a painful mistake.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord was a master far above me. Showing him my full strength without inflicting any significant injury had been a painful mistake.

hunks.baseline: *Should I have used One Annihilation from the beginning?*
hunks.sol: *Should I have used One Annihilation from the start?*

hunks.baseline: What would have happened if I had gone all in from the start?
hunks.sol: What would have happened if I’d gone all in from the beginning?

hunks.baseline: I sent the thought flying far away. Even if I could return to that moment, I probably would not be able to stake everything on one move.
hunks.sol: I cast the thought aside. Even if I could return to that moment, I probably still wouldn’t be able to stake everything on one move.

hunks.baseline: A gamble with only all or nothing as the possible outcomes had to be avoided. Especially when not only my own life but someone else’s was on the line.
hunks.sol: I had to avoid gambles that left only total victory or utter ruin—especially when lives other than my own hung in the balance.

hunks.baseline: *And… I haven’t played all my cards yet.*
hunks.sol: *Besides… I haven’t played all my cards yet.*

hunks.baseline: Unlike our first clash, neither of us launched finger qi or daggers.
hunks.sol: Unlike our first clash, neither of us launched Finger Qi or daggers.

hunks.baseline: We measured the distance between us, watched each other’s hands and feet, and waited for the right moment.
hunks.sol: We measured the distance, watched each other’s hands and feet, and waited for the right moment.

hunks.baseline: For a moment exactly like this.
hunks.sol: A moment exactly like this one.

hunks.baseline: He erased thirty feet of distance in a single step, and his hand blurred. His snake sword, with its winding, serpentine shape, burned with ink-black Sword Force.
hunks.sol: He erased thirty feet in a single step, his hand blurring. Ink-black Sword Force burned along his crooked, serpentine Snake Sword.

hunks.baseline: If there was a gap even the System could not bridge, it was the existence of enlightenment.
hunks.sol: If there was one gap even the System couldn’t bridge, it was enlightenment.

hunks.baseline: Those who had attained the insight needed to reach Supreme Peak and those who had not—the difference between them was as vast as heaven and earth.
hunks.sol: The difference between someone who had attained the insight required to reach Supreme Peak and someone who had not was as vast as heaven and earth.

hunks.baseline: No matter how great my strength was, if I kept colliding with Sword Force, I would inevitably suffer internal injuries.
hunks.sol: No matter how great my strength was, if I repeatedly clashed with Sword Force, I would inevitably suffer internal injuries.

hunks.baseline: The instant the Sword Force split the ground, a crater that looked like something out of a movie formed with a thunderous roar. If I had not barely evaded that strike, I would certainly have been cut in half.
hunks.sol: The Sword Force split the ground, blasting out a crater that looked like something from a movie. If I hadn’t barely dodged the strike, it would have cut me in half.

hunks.baseline: I had never formally learned the art of throwing daggers, but daggers fired with tremendous force and speed possessed power all on their own.
hunks.sol: I had never formally learned the art of throwing blades, but with enough force and speed behind them, the daggers were deadly in their own right.

hunks.baseline: Of course, that did not apply against the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
hunks.sol: Not that it mattered against the Western Heaven Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: A single horizontal line.
hunks.sol: A single horizontal line flashed through the air.

hunks.baseline: Ink-black Sword Energy shot out along the blade, slicing through the daggers as it flew toward me.
hunks.sol: Ink-black Sword Energy shot from his blade, slicing through the daggers and flying straight at me.

hunks.baseline: I tilted my head to the side. The intense heat and Sword Energy grazed past me.
hunks.sol: I tilted my head, and searing heat and Sword Energy grazed past me.

hunks.baseline: Ignoring the roar and vibrations echoing behind me, I planted my foot on the ground.
hunks.sol: Ignoring the roar and tremor behind me, I planted my foot.

hunks.baseline: The solid stone floor split like a spiderweb. In the next instant, I shot forward like a flash of light.
hunks.sol: The solid stone floor split like a spiderweb. The next instant, I shot forward like a streak of light.

hunks.baseline: My speed was fast enough to be considered a Supreme Peak movement technique—or perhaps even faster.
hunks.sol: I moved with enough speed to rival a Supreme Peak movement technique—perhaps even surpass one.

hunks.baseline: With a short exclamation, the Western Heaven Demon Lord swung his sword downward.
hunks.sol: With a short exclamation, the Western Heaven Demon Lord brought his sword down.

hunks.baseline: Ink-black Sword Force, dark enough to swallow the surrounding light, cut across my entire body.
hunks.sol: Ink-black Sword Force, so dark that it dimmed the very air around it, swept across my body.

hunks.baseline: If not for the single thought that had flashed through my mind before that split-second moment, it certainly would have.
hunks.sol: It would have cut me apart, if not for the thought that had flashed through my mind a fraction of an instant earlier.

hunks.baseline: The change was dazzlingly fast. My entire body grew lighter, while my muscles gained density and springiness and squeezed out every last bit of strength.
hunks.sol: The change came with dazzling speed. My whole body grew lighter, while my muscles gained density and elasticity, squeezing out every last bit of strength.

hunks.baseline: As my body stepped on the wind, the ink-black Sword Force sliced through empty air.
hunks.sol: As I stepped upon the wind, the ink-black Sword Force sliced through empty air.

hunks.baseline: I saw the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes widen.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes flew wide.

hunks.baseline: It was already too late for him to retrieve his sword. He hurriedly stretched out his other hand and tried to seize the spear approaching his chest.
hunks.sol: It was already too late for him to pull back his sword. He thrust out his other hand, trying to seize the spear hurtling toward his chest.
His reflexes were astonishing.

hunks.baseline: His reflexes were astonishing. But if there was one other thing that astonished me, it was that my prediction had been exactly right.
hunks.sol: Just as astonishing was the fact that my prediction had been exactly right.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s hand, wrapped in Force, swept through empty air.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s Force-wreathed hand swept through empty air.

hunks.baseline: The spear that had seemed certain to be caught—White Flame—should now be safely tucked away somewhere inside my inventory.
hunks.sol: The spear that had seemed certain to fall into his grasp—White Flame—was now safely tucked away somewhere in my inventory.

hunks.baseline: And this was the moment I had been waiting for.
hunks.sol: This was the moment I had been waiting for.

hunks.baseline: My right hand, engulfed in blue flames, slammed into the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s abdomen.
hunks.sol: My right hand, wreathed in blue flames, slammed into the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s abdomen.

hunks.baseline: The moment his body rose slightly into the air amid tremendous heat, I swung the fist I had prepared with my left hand.
hunks.sol: His body lifted slightly into the air amid the tremendous heat. At that exact moment, I drove my waiting left fist forward.

hunks.baseline: The strike that had brought down a cliff slammed into the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s side.
hunks.sol: The strike that had brought down a cliff buried itself in the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s side.

hunks.baseline: The impact traveled through my fingertips. His body flew like a cannonball and slammed into the wall.
hunks.sol: The impact ran back through my fingertips. His body flew like a cannonball and smashed into the wall.

hunks.baseline: The entire underground prison shuddered. At the same time, an unbearable weakness and hunger washed over me.
hunks.sol: The entire underground prison shuddered. At the same time, unbearable weakness and hunger washed over me.

hunks.baseline: It had been an exchange in which I had poured my full strength into every movement. Naturally, ragged breaths spilled between my lips.
hunks.sol: I had poured everything I had into every movement of that exchange. No wonder ragged breaths spilled from my lips.

hunks.baseline: “If I ask, will you answer me?”

hunks.sol: I looked down at the Western Heaven Demon Lord as he weakly nodded.

hunks.baseline: “Quit the lousy acting and get up. And cut it out with those coughs that don’t even produce blood.”
hunks.sol: “Drop the lousy act and get up. And enough with the coughing when you’re not even bringing up blood.”

hunks.baseline: You son of a bitch.
